sources_read: canonical Obadiah coordinates and received 66-book text
independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.form: vision heading, international summons, and pride-to-humiliation oracle
chunks.marker: Vision/speech/news/ambassador frame opens the book; second-person height and security claims culminate in the answering I-will-bring-you-down verdict.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep heading, summons, accusation, and reversal together; decide no authorship, date, source, history, nation identity, or theology.
chunks.risk: Vision attribution, messenger formula, nations, Edom referent, height imagery, speaker, source relation, date, and event remain unresolved.

chunks.form: total-plunder comparisons, ally betrayal, and wisdom-warrior collapse
chunks.marker: Thief and grape-gatherer questions contrast ordinary loss with exhaustive plunder; Esau's treasures, allies, wisdom, and Teman's warriors then collapse cumulatively.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize comparisons or inventories, resolve verse 7, or map Esau/Edom/allies/Teman to a later nation, territory, or event.
chunks.risk: Comparison syntax, Esau naming, treasures, alliance/bread/snare wording, wisdom, Teman, slaughter, ethics, and history remain unresolved.

chunks.form: brother-violence indictment and repeated in-the-day prohibition chain
chunks.marker: For-violence states charge and consequence; repeated in-the-day clauses and do-not commands accumulate from passive standing through rejoicing, entering, seizing, cutting off, and handing over.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve the cumulative accusation; decide no invasion event, brother/nation identity, collective liability, war ethic, chronology, or modern application.
chunks.risk: Violence, brother Jacob, Jerusalem, foreigners, lots, viewpoint, imperatives, refugees, complicity, history, and ethics remain unresolved.

chunks.form: day-of-YHWH proportional reversal and nations-drinking comparison
chunks.marker: For the day is near broadens to all nations and states as-you-did reversal; for-as-you-drank extends reciprocity until but-on-Zion turns at verse 17.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify the drinking event, construct a day chronology, settle judgment ethics, or declare historical or eschatological fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Nearness, all-nations scope, deed-return, addressee, holy-mountain drinking, annihilation language, chronology, ethics, and fulfillment remain unresolved.

chunks.form: Zion escape-holiness reversal, house-fire image, possession register, and kingdom close
chunks.marker: But on Mount Zion reverses the nations close; escape/holiness/possess language grows through house-fire contrast, a coordinated territorial register, ascending saviors/judges, and the terminal kingdom clause.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Prefer the whole close over Zion, fire, territory, savior, judgment, or kingdom proof texts; decide no ethnic equation, violence ethic, land program, messianic identity, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Escape, holiness, possession, Jacob/Joseph/Esau houses, fire, no-survivor claim, territories, exiles, Sepharad, saviors/judges, kingdom, geography, ethics, and fulfillment remain unresolved.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Jeremiah 49 overlap becomes confident source direction, borrowing, authorship, date, or layer.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use overlap only to test units; leave direction and composition unresolved.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Edom, Esau, Jacob, Joseph, Judah, Israel, Teman, or territories are flattened into one ancient or modern identity.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain received labels and discourse roles without harmonizing identities, borders, or later claimants.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Day clauses are tied to a selected destruction of Jerusalem to establish authorship/date/history.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve the accusation chain and defer event, viewpoint, authorship, and date.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Violence, cutting off, drinking, fire, devouring, or no-remnant rhetoric becomes ethics authority.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep charge and reversal in literary parents; defer violence and judgment ethics.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: The day of YHWH is assigned one historical or eschatological schedule, referent, or fulfillment.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve the two-verse reversal and treat other day passages as parallels only.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Zion, possession, territories, saviors/judges, or kingdom becomes a territorial, geopolitical, ecclesial, messianic, or theological program.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep the whole close and defer identities, geography, politics, fulfillment, and theology.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: A translation, Hebrew parsing, witness, emendation, or later reception is preferred to settle a seam or meaning.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain exact alternatives and LOW confidence; source metadata is evidence only.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Canonical relations become dependence, graph truth, canon hierarchy, doctrine, or theology authority.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Relations remain non-directional context requiring external/human adjudication.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: The short book remains a chapter fallback or is atomized into similes, prohibitions, names, places, and proof texts.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use five movements while retaining 1-9, 10-16, and 17-21 as larger fallback parents.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Dense overlap in Edom address, nations summons, height/pride reversal, thief/grape comparisons, plunder, wisdom, and Teman.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No direction, dependence, common source, authorship, date, event, preferred wording, canon hierarchy, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Esau/Jacob brother language and Edom/Seir/Teman, kinship, land, route, and conflict vocabulary contextualize labels.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No identity collapse, genealogy-to-modern-nation equation, border claim, collective guilt, historical harmonization, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Jerusalem calamity, Edom, brother violence, rejoicing, refugees, vengeance, and recompense pressure the accusation chain.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No event identification, direction, chronology, modern identity, violence ethic, collective liability, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Day-of-YHWH, nations, nearness, reciprocal judgment, holy-mountain, and drinking/cup imagery cluster around the reversal.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No direction, shared event, timetable, eschatological system, fulfillment, judgment ethic, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Zion, escape/remnant, holiness, possession, geography, judgment, nations, and kingdom accompany a closing reversal.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No direction, territorial program, Israel/church equation, messianic identity, chronology, fulfillment, canon hierarchy, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Later canonical uses of Jacob/Esau/Edom provide reuse context without fixing Obadiah's local referents or structure.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No quotation/dependence where unproven, canon direction, election system, individual/corporate identity ruling, ethics, or theology authority.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observed_relation: Later discourse combines distress, escape/salvation, day, Zion/Jerusalem, and kingdom language in distinct settings.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No prediction-fulfillment identity, direct quotation, timeline, Zion equation, kingdom system, canon hierarchy, or theology.

hardest_boundary_order.current_action: Recognize seam but retain 15-21 as exact larger alternative; LOW; defer chronology, identity, ethics, fulfillment, and theology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Cut-off language continues, but for-the-violence shifts into explicit brother-Jacob accusation and repeated day chain.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: Retain seam with 1-16 context; LOW; defer source, history, identity, and ethics.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Accusation leads into day-of-YHWH generalization; splitting can detach reversal while merging obscures the all-nations horizon.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: Keep linked movements with 10-16 alternative; LOW; defer chronology, event, ethics, and fulfillment.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Bring-you-down continues into plunder, but thief/grape questions begin a new sequence echoed in Jeremiah.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: Retain seam but preserve 1-9 parent; LOW; defer direction, witness, authorship, date, and history.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Speech formula closes house-fire/no-remnant, while possess vocabulary links verse 17 through the territory register and kingdom.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: Do not split final candidate unit; keep 17-18 + 19-21 only as alternative; LOW; defer violence, territory, identity, and fulfillment.
